cards.title: let can change
cards.body: A `const` never changes. Use `let` for a variable you will update later.

hi.title: let badal sakta hai
hi.body: `const` kabhi nahi badalta. Jo variable baad mein update karna ho, uske liye `let` use karo.

cards.title: Shortcuts
cards.body: `score += 5` is short for `score = score + 5`, and `count++` adds 1.

hi.title: Shortcuts
hi.body: `score += 5` ka matlab `score = score + 5`, aur `count++` 1 jodta hai.

cards.title: const protects values
cards.body: Assigning to a `const` again is an error. Use `const` for values you never mean to change, and `let` only when you do.

hi.title: const values ko bachata hai
hi.body: `const` ko dobara value dena error hai. Jo values kabhi nahi badalni unke liye `const` use karo, aur `let` sirf tab jab badalni hon.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It stops with `TypeError: Assignment to constant variable.` Which line needs to change?

bug.fix: A `const` can never get a new value, and line 2 changes `score`. Line 1 should use `let`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Yeh `TypeError: Assignment to constant variable.` dekar ruk jaata hai. Kaunsi line badalni chahiye?
hi.fix: `const` ko kabhi nayi value nahi mil sakti, aur line 2 `score` ko badalti hai. Line 1 mein `let` hona chahiye.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: `x *= 5` se x 10 ho jaata hai, phir `x++` 1 jodta hai.

exercise.prompt: Read a starting balance, then a deposit, then a withdrawal (whole numbers, one per line). Add the deposit, take away the withdrawal, and print the final balance.
exercise.promptHi: Pehle starting balance padho, phir ek deposit, phir ek withdrawal (whole numbers, har line mein ek). Deposit jodo, withdrawal ghatao, aur final balance print karo.
